messages:
Rae: Quick copy pass request — when a user saves a preset that has the same name as an existing preset we show an overwrite confirmation. Current title: 'Save preset?'. Feels soft and ambiguous about impact. Also worried about users thinking model files or deployments change.
Ben: Good catch. We should be explicit about scope: are we overwriting only the preset metadata (config) or touching running routes? Need a checkbox option for 'Also update routes that use this preset'.
Sofia: Suggested title: 'Overwrite preset "{name}"?' Body: short lead then bullets: - Replaces the preset configuration (quantization, batch size, timeout). - Does not modify model weights. - Optionally update routes now. That should cover common confusions.
Aaron: Button labels: Primary = 'Overwrite preset' (dangerous action), Secondary = 'Cancel', Tertiary = 'Save as new preset' (non-destructive alternative). Inline checkbox: label = 'Also update routes using this preset' helper = 'Routes that reference this preset will use the new settings immediately.'
Rae: Accessibility: dialog should have role=dialog, aria-labelledby -> title, aria-describedby -> bullets. Checkbox needs clear accessible name and description. Focus should default to Cancel to avoid accidental overwrite.
Ben: Microcopy edge cases: if preset is in use by production routes show a red inline callout: 'In use by 3 live routes — updating will affect production traffic.' For that callout include a 'View routes' link.
Sofia: Example full modal copy (compact): Title: 'Overwrite preset "high-throughput"?' Body: 'This replaces the preset configuration (quantization, batch size, timeouts). It will not change model weights or versions.' Bullets: - 'Replaces preset configuration' - 'Does not modify model weights' - 'Routes update immediately if checkbox selected' Checkbox label + helper as Aaron suggested. Buttons: 'Cancel' (autofocus), 'Save as new preset', 'Overwrite preset' (danger).
Aaron: Also include a small aria-live region for the checkbox state change if routes count is shown: 'Also update routes selected — affects 3 routes' so SR reads the impact.
DesignBot: A11y checklist: role=dialog, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, focus trap, initial focus on the less-dangerous button, checkbox with aria-describedby for helper text, provide visible confirmation toast after overwrite with role=status and aria-live=polite. If production routes affected, toast should include link to activity log. Ensure color contrast of callout meets AA.
Rae: For the overwrite toast copy: 'Preset "high-throughput" updated. {n} routes updated.' If routes updated = 0 then 'Preset updated. No routes were changed.' Use explicit counts. Primary toast action: 'View changes' Secondary: 'Undo' (if undo supported).
Ben: Undo semantics: if we offer undo, microcopy while undoing: 'Reverting preset changes' (SR: 'Reverting preset changes'). On success: 'Reverted' toast. If not supported: toast must not promise undo.
Sofia: Also add microcopy for the 'Save as new preset' flow: default name suggestion 'high-throughput (copy)' helper: 'Rename to keep both versions.' Keep it short.
Aaron: Internationalization note: avoid contractions and punctuation that complicate translation. Keep sentences short.
Rae: I'll update the UX spec with these strings and the a11y checklist. I'll also flag Eng to ensure we can surface live-route counts and support an undo or clearly remove that option from copy. Thanks all :sparkles:
